title: Annual Speeds per Network Link
description: One row of Replica's "Annual Speeds per Network Link" dataset. Derived from the published schema table at https://documentation.replicahq.com/docs/free-flow-speed-per-network-link.

stable_edge_id.description: A unique identifier for each road segment.

osm_id.description: OSM Way ID (version 2021-09-01 for the 2021 data; version 2022-12-01 for the 2022 data)

street_name.description: The common name of the network link if available. Matches the name assigned by OpenStreetMap.

highway.description: The classification of the link based on OpenStreetMap data if available.

length.description: The length of the network link in meters.

lanes.description: The number of lanes in the network link.

heading.description: The heading of the network link.

compass_direction.description: The compass direction of the network link.

geometry.description: Orientation of speed relative to OSM way (True: parallel, False: antiparallel).

speed_limit_mph.description: Speed limit of the network link in miles per hour

average_speed_mph.description: Average speed for the newtork link in miles per hour

free_flow_speed_mph.description: Free flow speed for the network link in miles per hour.

speed_p50_mph.description: Median of speeds for the network link in miles per hour.

speed_p85_mph.description: Percentile 85 of speeds for the network link in miles per hour.

speed_p95_mph.description: Percentile 95 of speeds for the network link in miles per hour.
